{How did former world champion Vishy Anand handle the threat to his c5 pawn?} 9. b4
{[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find the best way to defend c5.] [%hint
Defend your c-pawn.]} (9. cxb6 $2 axb6 {Black is doing well. Try again.}) (9.
Ne5 $2 Nxe5 {Black is slightly better. Try again.}) 9... a5 {Good start! How
can you keep everything defended?} 10. a3 {[%wrong There's a stronger move.
Try to find the best way to defend b4.] [%hint Defend the b4 pawn with another
pawn.]} (10. b5 $5 {This is playable, but it's better to defend the b4. How?})
(10. cxb6 $2 axb4 {Black will win a pawn. Try again.}) 10... Ba6 {Nice move!
How should White handle the tension between the bishops?} 11. Bxa6 {[%wrong
There's a stronger move. Try to find a good capture.] [%hint Lure the a8 rook
to a square where it can be attacked.] Well played! You can continue this
exciting game between Anand and Magnus Carlsen in the next challenge.} (11. O-O
$5 {This is playable, but Vishy preferred to start play on the queenside
immediately. What did he play?}) (11. b5 $5 Bb7 {This is playable, but Black
has everything defended. Try to find a way to make the b5 push more dangerous.}
) 1-0

{How can White create a dangerous passed pawn?} 12. b5 {[%wrong There's a
stronger move. Try to find it and check the hint if you're stuck.] [%hint
Sacrifice a pawn to create a passer on the queenside.]} (12. Qd3 $5 {This is
playable, but Vishy found an aggressive move to create a passed pawn. What did
he play?}) (12. O-O $5 {This is playable, but Vishy found an aggressive move
to create a passed pawn. What did he play?}) (12. h3 $5 {This is playable, but
Vishy found an aggressive move to create a passed pawn. What did he play?}) (

passed pawn. What did he play?}) 12... cxb5 {Well played! How can you create a
passed pawn?} 13. c6 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find a good pawn
push.] [%hint Create a passed pawn and attack a piece.]} (13. Nxb5 $2 bxc5 {
Black is better. Try again.}) (13. cxb6 $2 Rxb6 {Black is better. Try again.})
13... Qc8 {Good move! Black pinned the c6 pawn. What did Vishy play?} 14. c7 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find a way to save your c-pawn.] [%hint
Keep your c-pawn alive.]} (14. Nxb5 $2 Qxc6 {Black is doing well. Try again.})
(14. O-O $2 Qxc6 {Black is better. Try again.}) 14... b4 {Nice move! How
should you save your knight?} 15. Nb5 {[%wrong Black wins material. Try again
to save your knight.] [%hint Save your knight and over-protect the c7 pawn.]
Great job! White has good chances in this sharp position thanks to the
powerful pawn on c7. Anand went on to score his only match win against Carlsen.
} (15. Na4 $2 b5 {Black wins material. Try again.}) (15. Ne2 $2 bxa3 {Black
wins material. Try again.}) (15. Nb1 $2 a4 {Black wins material. Try again.}) (
15. Na2 $2 bxa3 {Black wins material. Try again.}) (15. axb4 $2 Bxb4 {Black
wins material. Try again.}) 1-0

slightly better, but there's an even stronger option. Try to find it.}) (20. h4
$2 Re8 {Black is OK. Try again.}) (20. Bxg5 $2 b3 {Black is better. Try again.}
) (20. Qxa4 $2 Ra5 {Black is OK. Try again.}) (20. Bxb4 $2 Rxb4 {Black emerges
with a material advantage. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) 20...
Re8 {Well played! What's next?} 21. Qxa4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try
to find a strong capture.] [%hint Win the b5 rook instead of saving the bishop.
]} (21. Bxg5 $2 Rxb4 {Black is OK. Try again.}) 21... Rxe7 {Well played! How
can you win material?} 22. Qxb5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find a
way to win material.] [%hint What can you capture?] Great job! The passed
c-pawn and active pieces provide White with a winning advantage.} *

{How should Black open a file and trade into a defendable ending?} 14... axb4 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a strong capture.] 
[%hint Find a capture to open the a-file.]} (14... Nh5 $5 {This is OK, but
there's a capture that's stronger. Try to find it.}) (14... bxc5 $2 15. bxc5 {
White will soon dominate the open b-file. Try again and look for a stronger
capture.}) (14... b5 $5 {This is OK, but there's a capture that's stronger.
Try to find it.}) 15. axb4 {Good start! How should you exchange pieces to
dampen the effects of White's space advantage?} Rxa1 {[%wrong There's a
stronger move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Trade rooks.]} (
15... Ra7 $5 {This is OK, but most players with the black pieces prefer a
strong capture. Try to find it.}) (15... b5 $5 {This is OK, but most players
with the black pieces prefer a strong capture. Try to find it.}) (15... h6 $5 {
This is OK, but most players with the black pieces prefer a strong capture.
Try to find it.}) (15... bxc5 $2 16. bxc5 {Black's queen will be vulnerable on
the newly opened file and the c6-pawn may be hard to defend as well. Try again
and look for a stronger capture.}) (15... Nh5 $5 {This is reasonable, but most
strong players choose an immediate exchange. Try to find it.}) 16. Rxa1 {
Nice move! How did GM Aronian prepare to trade another set of pieces?} Ra8 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a way to fight for an
open file.] [%hint Offer a trade on the a-file.] Well played! White must trade
rooks or concede the only open file. Black soon secured the draw in Mamedyarov
- Aronian, 2018.} (16... bxc5 $5 {This is playable, but it's stronger to fight
for the only open file. How should you do it?}) (16... b5 $2 17. Nxb5 {White
will get at least two passed pawns in exchange for a knight and Black has a
difficult position. Try again and look for a way to fight for the only open
file.}) *
